title: Review result (Issue #67)
description: Machine-readable serialization of one completed review: its findings, the decision derived from them, and the review-level metadata. Shape only -- every field's meaning is owned by the canonical source named in its $comment (see review-result-model.md, section 3); this schema restates none of those rules. Cross-field consistency (counts, decision derivation, identity) is checked against those owners by tests/reference/review/review_result.py, not encoded here.

schema_version.$comment: Versioning policy (when this value changes, compatibility rules) is Issue #68's; this constant is the only place the version is stated.

skill.$comment: Which Code Review Agent Skill produced the review: skills/local-code-review/SKILL.md or skills/github-pr-review/SKILL.md.

reviewed_state.$comment: The facts a Reviewed State Record binds to a completed review: docs/findings/reviewed-sha-state-contract.md, section 1 (fields), section 2 (which SHA is authoritative), section 5 (completeness and prior reviewed SHA). Persistence fields (provenance marker, associated review evidence reference) belong to a written record, not to the result, and are not carried here.

reviewed_head_sha.$comment: null when the review target has no committed head (for example uncommitted local changes); such a result cannot seed a delta re-review (reviewed-sha-state-contract.md, section 7).

reviewer_identity.$comment: null when the reviewer identity could not be established (reviewed-sha-state-contract.md, section 4).

prior_reviewed_sha.$comment: null only at the supersession-chain root (reviewed-sha-state-contract.md, section 5).

coverage.$comment: shared/policies/review-stopping-criteria.md, 'Labeling'. An incomplete review must never present as clean; that override is reflected in decision.outcome.

derived.$comment: The one mechanical decision shared/policies/severity.md, 'Decision derivation (mechanical)', derives from the finding set: clean (no unresolved P0/P1) or blocking. Skill-specific labels (REVIEW CLEAN / Approve, CHANGES REQUIRED / Request Changes) are renderings of these two values; see review-result-model.md, section 4.

outcome.$comment: The primary outcome the review presents: 'derived', except an incomplete coverage state overrides it with 'incomplete' (review-stopping-criteria.md, 'Labeling').

counts.$comment: The severity tally severity.md's derivation is stated over (its 'P0: 0, P1: 1' basis). Each count equals the number of findings of that severity.

summary.$comment: The review's 'What changed' section (shared/templates/review-summary.md); presentation prose, never an input to the decision.

findings.$comment: Every finding the review produced, in report order -- including P2 findings on a clean review (severity.md: REVIEW CLEAN means no blocking findings, not no findings).

finding.$comment: shared/templates/finding.md, 'Fields' (the canonical finding contract) and 'Optional and surface-specific fields'. Rendering-only fields (source annotation on location, implementation prompt) are not part of the result.

id.$comment: finding.md 'id': the review-local identifier (F1, F2, ...). Cross-review identity is 'identity' below, not this field.

severity.$comment: finding.md 'severity'; definitions and blocking rule are shared/policies/severity.md.

location.$comment: finding.md 'location': the canonical fix/action location, free-form (file, line/range, symbol, or section). Its parsing belongs to the identity contract, not this schema.

fix_location_resolved.$comment: finding.md, 'Fix/action location, evidence location, publication'. false means 'location' is only the best-known evidence coordinate and the fix/action location is unresolved. Always present so an absent key is never read as 'resolved'.

evidence_location.$comment: finding.md 'evidence location'. Omitted when it adds nothing over 'location'.

affected_locations.$comment: finding.md 'affected locations': the exhaustive manifestation sites of a consolidated root-cause finding (at least two). Omitted on an ordinary single-site finding.

evidence.$comment: finding.md 'evidence'; the evidence bar is shared/policies/evidence.md.

fix.$comment: finding.md 'fix' -- the field that carries the remediation direction governed by shared/policies/remediation-guidance.md.

follow_up.$comment: finding.md 'follow-up'; shared/policies/remediation-scope-boundary.md. Omitted when there is none.

details.$comment: finding.md 'details' (the controlled longer explanation). Omitted when there is none.

runtime_validation.$comment: finding.md 'runtime validation'; shared/policies/runtime-validation.md, 'Targeted validation of a suspected finding'. 'reasoned' is the canonical default (no targeted validation attempted), carried explicitly so it is never confused with an omitted key.

contextual_evidence.$comment: finding.md 'contextual evidence': provenance entries, each a short 'source: clause' string. Omitted when no contextual evidence informed the finding.

confidence.$comment: finding.md 'confidence' and docs/finding-confidence/finding-confidence-model.md: the closed evidence-state value set. 'credible' is the canonical default, carried explicitly.

capability.$comment: finding.md 'capability'; shared/policies/specialist-depth.md. Omitted when no domain-specific deepening capability contributed.

defect_kind.$comment: finding.md 'defect_kind': a lowercase kebab-case defect-class slug. Omitted when no narrow class applies.

identity.$comment: docs/findings/finding-stable-identity.md: the effective identity a finding carries out of a review (section 1) and its fail-closed matching eligibility (section 7). Construction, propagation and matching are owned there and in finding-matching-strategy.md; lifecycle state is finding-lifecycle-contract.md's and is not carried in the result.
